entities.summary: Carlo Maria Polvani is a Roman Catholic prelate and Secretary at the Dicastery for Culture and Education. Before this he worked in the Section for General Affairs of the Secretariate of State and the Pontifical Council for Culture. On January 12, 2025, he was appointed as the titular archbishop of Regie.
